newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Parmalat buys Australian dairy firm.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Parmalat buys Australian dairy firm.

text.p: Italian food company Parmalat Spa said on Wednesday it had acquired the unlisted and family-owned Australian milk production company Haberfields Dairy Group.
Parmalat, which is based in the northern city of Milan, did not disclose the purchase price.
It said Haberfields, which has plants on either side of the New South Wales and Victorian borders in eastern Australia, has annual sales of about A$20 million.
The company said this was its first Australian purchase and it planned to expand through organic growth and future acquisitions.
"The enormous scope of opportunities for Parmalat in Australia allows for export of Australian made products to Asia and other 'Parmalat' countries," the company said.
